note: TOTAL_WALL is the harness-measured process wall clock. MODEL_WAIT is the sum of model_requests.latency_ms, which spans a round including any retry. TOOL_EXECUTION is tool_call_started -> tool_call_finished from the event log, and verification runs as a tool call, so it is inside that figure. HARNESS_OVERHEAD is the residual.
aggregate_note: The aggregate covers only runs that ended on their own. One yq run was killed at its 1800s timeout; its unattributed 81s is the round that was in flight, not runtime overhead.
